id: title:Gilbert09:gate connecting an integration on project admin

review.posthog_relevance: Checks membership level before allowing integration setup, potentially restricting access for users without project admin privileges.
review.reason: Adds a membership-level check and a disabled reason to the integration setup menu, preventing setup for users lacking project admin. This is a localized access control and behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The exact membership tier and the specific OAuth flow issue are not fully described, and the broader impact on user experience or system stability is not demonstrated.
